# Wix

> > Wix is an AI-powered website builder and development platform offering drag-and-drop design, eCommerce solutions, templates, and headless CMS capabilities.

Wix provides comprehensive web creation tools including Wix Studio for professionals, Wixel for design resources, and business solutions spanning eCommerce, bookings, CRM, and domain registration. The platform supports both no-code builders and developers with headless APIs and the Model Context Protocol server.

## Key Topics

- Wix Studio
- Wix Store (eCommerce)
- Website Builder
- Website Templates
- Headless CMS
- Wixel (Design Tools)
- SEO & Marketing
- SSL/HTTPS Security
- Business Solutions
- Drag-and-Drop Editor
- AI-Powered Design
- Domain Registration
- MCP Server
- GDPR & Data Protection
- Mobile Commerce

## Core Platform & Website Builder

- [Website Builder - Create a Free Website In Minutes | Wix.com](https://www.wix.com): Wix homepage: AI-powered website builder with 2,000+ templates
- [Drag and Drop Website Builder: Create For Free - Wix.com](https://www.wix.com/builder/drag-and-drop): Wix drag-and-drop website builder with templates and AI features
- [Business Solutions | Wix Studio](https://www.wix.com/studio/business-solutions): Wix Studio business solutions: eCommerce, Bookings, CMS, and CRM
- [.com Domain | Buy and Register Your Perfect Domain Name.](https://www.wix.com/domains/tld-list/tlds/com-domain): .com domain registration and hosting service from Wix
- [Business Phone Number | Get a Virtual Phone Line | Wix.com](https://www.wix.com/business-phone-number): Virtual business phone with Google Voice integration for US/Canada
